# ULTRON 1.0.0 — macOS Apple Silicon

This download is for Macs with Apple Silicon: M1, M2, M3 and later.

The release contains the ULTRON desktop app and a SHA-256 checksum. It is built
and verified on an Apple Silicon macOS runner from the tagged source commit.

Install by downloading the ZIP, comparing the checksum, unzipping it, and
moving ULTRON ai.app to Applications.
